name: photos-storage-cleaner
description: Chrome extension that finds duplicate and similar Google Photos with on-device AI and frees Google storage.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:mock: VITE_MOCK_ADAPTER=1 vite build --mode development && VITE_MOCK_ADAPTER=1 vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development
